def claim_row(proposal_id):
    """Mark the row applied so a second caller cannot write it again."""
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE distill_staging SET status = 'applied' WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
        (proposal_id,),
    )
    return fetch(proposal_id) if cur.rowcount else None
